title: OBVIL — corpus d'éditions anciennes françaises (Teinte)
notes: Born-digital TEI corpora of early-modern French texts from LabEx OBVIL (Sorbonne Université), encoded with the Teinte toolchain (lauze_apologie-danse_1623, Faceties 1557, La Bruyère 1694, etc.); CC BY-NC-ND. The lab's data platform ObTIC (obtic.sorbonne-universite.fr/corpus, verified) indexes the freely available OBVIL corpora; the reading corpus pages live on the OBVIL GitHub organisation (https://github.com/OBVIL), and obvil.sorbonne-universite.fr refused connections at check time. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
